name: fig16_effective_potentials
caption: Effective potentials V = f [l(l+1)/r^2 + (1 - s^2) r_s/r^3] for massless fields of spin s = 0, 1, 2 (units r_s = 1). The barrier peak lies near the photon sphere and rises like l(l+1); the scattering of waves off it determines the greybody factor. All potentials vanish at the horizon and decay as l(l+1)/r^2 at infinity.
